main_body: cylindrical marble column with a wider capital at the top and a matching molded base at the bottom
top_band: light off-white marble horizontal surface at rows 9-11 bounded by a bright white front-edge highlight line at row 12
evidence: Reading down the middle column: row 8 is the top dark outline, rows 9-11 form a 3-row light marble horizontal top surface (narrower at row 9 for the rounded back edge), row 12 is a distinct 1px pure white front-edge highlight line, rows 13-15 form the shaded vertical face and lower rim of the capital, row 16 is an eave shadow where the capital overhangs the narrower shaft, and rows 17-46 form the cylindrical shaft and stepped base.

style.evidence: The marble ramp uses 8 distinct lightness steps from pure white specular highlights down to deep cool-grey shadows. Outlines are selective dark and mid-dark cool-grey material tones rather than uniform black, and every column of the 6px-wide shaft steps across the cylindrical gradient with vertical tapering near the neck and base, avoiding any flat fills.
